user_ruling: '回撤你看着来吧，其他决议部署然后赶快训练' (relayed by session QuantMind 训练特征构筑)

speed.reproducibility: selections and A-half rewards bit-identical to the baseline (SEL1_SPEED_V3/V4, SEL1_SELCHECK/SELCHECK2, SEL1_SPEED_V5); GPU backprop is not bit-reproducible (same code twice: weights differ by 2.1e-6), so pg_loss may differ in the last bit

reward.t: A half, 30 odd months: mean / (sd ddof 1 / sqrt 30) of the monthly cost0 beta-hedged log NAV; a month holding nothing is 0 and counts; sd 0 -> 0 (S.reward 't')
reward.dd: A-half max drawdown: the 30 A months' cost0 log NAV joined in order, cumulative from 0, marked at month ends, largest fall from the running peak (S.max_dd)

detectable: this training can only find signals of >= 20 bp/day (cost0, A-half gain of the plant book at K 5; the smallest passing strength)

worlds.PC: NULL world + plant (pcnull, the plant check's world), alpha 6.908190339580098e-05
worlds.NULL: NULL world (per-coin circular roll, NULL_SEED 20261015), no plant

rounds.pc: sel1_round --mode pc: found_corr = a hall entry with |corr| > 0.7 to the plant, else stop
rounds.null: sel1_round --mode null: T_null = max B-half t of the NULL hall; PC found = corr hit with t_B > T_null, else stop
rounds.real: sel1_round --mode real: gates 1-4 of order s2 + behaviour dedup
